notes: MiniMax M2.7 INT4 AutoRound served through an OpenAI-compatible vLLM/XPU endpoint on 4x Intel Arc Pro B70. This follow-up records endpoint-facing TTFT from vLLM Prometheus metrics, plus client streamed throughput. Served context is max_model_len=32768 after moving display duty to onboard ASPEED VGA and booting with xe.disable_display=1. Shape: p510/n1536, one warmup request excluded. Client streamed generated-token-only throughput after first text chunk: 85.453 tok/s; total throughput: 111.635 tok/s; vLLM TTFT: 351.068 ms; vLLM e2e latency: 18.326 s. A conservative prefill lower-bound was 1445.6 tok/s, computed as prompt tokens / TTFT, but tokSPrefill is intentionally omitted because the endpoint does not expose a separate prefill-complete timestamp. No speculative decoding, no expert dropping, no model/quantization/KV dtype change, no power-limit change.
